tasks.title: Add the logging configuration and module
tasks.description: Create server/src/logging/logging.config.ts with the redact list, resolveLogLevel, genReqId and customLogLevel, and server/src/logging/logging.module.ts exporting LoggerModule.forRoot over it. Silent under NODE_ENV=test.

tasks.title: Wire the logger into bootstrap and the app module
tasks.description: Import LoggingModule first in app.module.ts; in main.ts create the app with bufferLogs and call app.useLogger with the pino Logger, leaving helmet, cookie-parser, CORS, ValidationPipe and Swagger in their existing order.

tasks.title: Carry the request id into the error response
tasks.description: Extend HttpExceptionFilter to include requestId in the body, read from the request the logger attached it to, without changing statusCode or message.

tasks.title: Add the dependency and document LOG_LEVEL
tasks.description: Add nestjs-pino and pino-http to dependencies and pino-pretty to devDependencies, install to refresh the lockfile, and document LOG_LEVEL in server/.env.example.

tasks.title: Generate the Prisma client in CI
tasks.description: Add pnpm --filter server exec prisma generate between install and typecheck in .github/workflows/ci.yml, with a comment recording why the step exists (typecheck fails on a clean checkout without it).

tasks.title: Add the audit and secret-scan steps
tasks.description: Add pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high and a gitleaks secret scan to the workflow, both failing the job on a high or critical finding.

tasks.title: Record the logging contract
tasks.description: Add a short section to CONTRIBUTING.md: where the redact list lives, how to add a redacted field, that LOG_LEVEL is the only knob, and that logging is silent under NODE_ENV=test.

tasks.title: Measure the latency cost and record the CI result
tasks.description: Measure p95 on the health endpoint before and after wiring the logger (NFR-001), and record both, plus the CI run outcome and duration, in the implementation report.

tasks.title: Run the verification gates
tasks.description: Run pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, prettier --check on the changed files, sdrive verify api-skeleton-and-ci, and node .sdrive/scripts/validate-governance.js; record the exit codes.
